feedback: T1 and T2: syntax errors prevented correct output; T2 and T3 explanations miss all reference ideas on TF-IDF weighting and cosine similarity.

justification.code: 4: about half the tasks correct (T2 and T3 use the intended TfidfVectorizer), but T1 uses a different method, and there are runtime/syntax errors in all three tasks plus output mismatches in all three (as noted in the checks).
justification.explanation: 2: both explanations are vague and generic; neither covers any of the reference ideas (term frequency, inverse document frequency, logarithm, common words down-weighted, rare words weighted higher for T2; angle, dot product, norm, document length, direction for T3).
justification.documentation: 3: docstring present for the tokenize function and markdown headers are clear, but no other comments or docstrings.
